en.title: In-chat software reverse-engineering template
en.summary: Use a Grok Bot template wired to REA (open-source reverse-engineering) so you can take a tool apart inside the chat—open the template, drop in the target, proceed.
en.whyItWorks: Switching apps breaks focus. Connecting reverse-engineering inside the bot chat keeps questions, artifacts, and next steps in one thread.
workflowSteps: Open the reverse-engineering Grok Bot template that connects REA.
Name the tool or binary you want to inspect and your goal (understand flow, map APIs, find config surfaces).
Ask for a high-level map first: modules, entry points, interesting strings.
Drill into one subsystem at a time; keep findings in the same chat.
End with a plain-language summary and open questions—not a claim of full coverage.
en.promptTemplate:
You are my reverse-engineering copilot connected to REA.

Target: [TOOL/BINARY]
Goal: [e.g. map features, find config, understand data flow]
Constraints: Explain in clear steps. Separate facts observed via REA from hypotheses. Do not claim complete coverage.

Start with:
1) High-level map
2) Top 5 interesting entry points
3) Suggested next probe
Then wait for my direction before going deeper.
en.connectorsAndRoutines: Primary connector is the REA-linked template inside chat—no separate app hop for the main loop. Use on-demand sessions rather than a fixed daily routine unless you are auditing the same binary repeatedly.

setupSteps.title: Open the reverse-engineering template that connects REA
setupSteps.detail: Connectors this case lists: Template, REA connector, and Chat. Questions, artifacts, and next steps stay in that chat.

setupSteps.title: Send the prompt template and name the target
setupSteps.detail: The tool or binary, and your goal: understand flow, map APIs, or find config surfaces.

setupSteps.title: Ask for the high-level map first
setupSteps.detail: Modules, entry points, and interesting strings. The first reply gives a high-level map, the top 5 interesting entry points, and a suggested next probe, then waits for your direction.

setupSteps.title: Drill into one subsystem at a time
setupSteps.detail: Keep findings in the same chat. Facts observed via REA stay separate from hypotheses. The reply does not claim complete coverage.

setupSteps.title: End with a plain-language summary and open questions
setupSteps.detail: Use on-demand sessions. A fixed daily routine is only for auditing the same binary repeatedly.

acceptanceChecklist: A question about your target tool or binary, asked in the REA-connected template, is answered in that same chat, with no separate app for the main loop.
The first reply gives a high-level map, the top 5 interesting entry points, and a suggested next probe, then waits for your direction before going deeper.
Facts observed via REA are separated from hypotheses, and the reply does not claim complete coverage.
The session ends with a plain-language summary and open questions.

zh.title: 对话内软件逆向模板
zh.summary: 使用接入 REA（开源逆向工具）的 Grok Bot 模板，在对话里拆解目标工具——打开模板、丢入目标、继续追问。
zh.whyItWorks: 来回切应用会打断思路。把逆向能力接进 Bot 对话，问题、产物和下一步都留在同一线程。
workflowSteps: 打开已连接 REA 的逆向 Grok Bot 模板。
说明要检查的工具/二进制以及目标（理解流程、映射 API、找配置面）。
先要高层地图：模块、入口、有意思的字符串。
一次只深挖一个子系统，发现留在同一对话。
结束时给白话总结与未决问题——不要宣称已完整覆盖。
zh.promptTemplate:
你是接入 REA 的逆向副驾驶。

目标：[TOOL/BINARY]
目的：[如映射功能、找配置、理解数据流]
约束：步骤清晰；区分 REA 观察到的事实与假设；不宣称完整覆盖。

先输出：
1）高层地图
2）最值得看的 5 个入口
3）建议的下一步探测
然后等待我的指示再深入。
zh.connectorsAndRoutines: 主连接是对话内的 REA 模板，主循环无需另开应用。按需开会即可；除非反复审计同一二进制，否则不必每日例行。

setupSteps.title: 打开已连接 REA 的逆向模板
setupSteps.detail: 本案例列出的连接器：Template、REA connector、Chat。问题、产物和下一步都留在该对话里。

setupSteps.title: 发出本页的提示词模板，并写明目标
setupSteps.detail: 要检查的工具或二进制，以及目的：理解流程、映射 API，或找配置面。

setupSteps.title: 先要高层地图
setupSteps.detail: 模块、入口、有意思的字符串。第一条回复给出高层地图、最值得看的 5 个入口和建议的下一步探测，然后等待你的指示。

setupSteps.title: 一次只深挖一个子系统
setupSteps.detail: 发现留在同一对话。经 REA 观察到的事实与假设分开。回复不会宣称已经完整覆盖。

setupSteps.title: 用白话总结和未决问题收尾
setupSteps.detail: 按需开会即可。除非反复审计同一二进制，否则不必每日例行。

acceptanceChecklist: 在已连接 REA 的模板里询问目标工具或二进制时，回答留在同一对话，主循环不必另开应用。
第一条回复会给出高层地图、最值得看的 5 个入口，以及建议的下一步探测，然后等待你的指示再深入。
经 REA 观察到的事实会与假设分开，回复不会宣称已经完整覆盖。
会话结束时给出白话总结和未决问题。

source.excerpt:
I just built a Grok Bot template that reverse engineers software for you. ⚒️

It connects REA, the open-source reverse-engineering tool, so you can take apart any tool right inside the chat. No setup, no switching apps.

→ Open the template
→ Drop in the tool you want to
